bio.text: Don Leonard, a Democrat, won the May 2026 primary for Ohio's 15th Congressional District over former state Rep. Adam Miller and faces Republican Rep. Mike Carey in the November general election, according to NBC4.
NBC4 describes him as a professor at Ohio State University; his campaign website says he taught city and regional planning there for about ten years.
According to his campaign website, he spent two years in the U.S. Peace Corps in South America after college and was a postdoctoral researcher at Tulane University.

sources.title: One of central Ohio's closest races was to see who will challenge Mike Carey for U.S. House seat
